name: Starsealed Edict
description: A hefty tome containing the Royal Energy Commission's internal rules and procedures, with numerous entries dating back many years.
domain: Domain of Forgery: Scars of Cursed Obsession
bonus:
Increases CRIT DMG by 24%/30%/36%/42%/48%. The equipping character gains the Crystal Compounding effect when they use their Elemental Skill, increasing Elemental Mastery by 48/60/72/84/96 for 20s. During this time, the equipping character gains a Law of Combustion stack when a nearby party member triggers an Elemental Reaction. Each stack increases Elemental Mastery by an additional 24/30/36/42/48. Max 3 stacks. These stacks last until Crystal Compounding ends or the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill again.
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Each Law of Combustion stack also increases the equipping character's Stellar-Conduct CRIT DMG by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%.
These effects can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
